examples.title: Example 1: Drawing an Ellipse
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use fillOpacity and stroke to set the opacity and stroke color of an ellipse.

examples.title: Example 2: Drawing an Ellipse with Different Parameter Types for Width and Height
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to draw an ellipse using different length types of the width and height attributes.

examples.title: Example 3: Dynamically Setting Attributes of the Ellipse Component Using attributeModifier
examples.description: This example shows how to use attributeModifier to dynamically set the fill, fillOpacity, stroke, strokeDashArray, strokeDashOffset, strokeLineCap, strokeOpacity, strokeWidth, and antiAlias attributes of the Ellipse component.
